desc:
• CAKE MIX: Bake a delicious pound cake dessert

  • QUICK AND EASY: Make a cake by just adding a few simple ingredients as directed and popping in the oven

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add your own twist to these baking mixes or try tested and trusted Betty Crocker recipes

  • DELICIOUS & SPONGY: Enjoy the sweetness of this versatile cake mix and make it your own

  • CONTAINS: 16 oz (Pack of 12)
features:
Features

Rich, Classic Pound Cake Flavor
Delivers a moist, dense, and buttery-tasting cake with a smooth, tender crumb.

Easy to Prepare
Just add water (or milk), butter (or margarine), and eggs. Mix, pour, and bake—perfect for any skill level.

Versatile Baking Options
Ideal for loaf pans, bundt pans, or cupcakes. It can also be used as a base for trifles or layered desserts.

Generous Size
One 16-oz box yields a full-size pound cake—great for sharing or slicing throughout the week.

Customizable
Elevate with your favorite add-ins like lemon zest, vanilla, berries, nuts, chocolate chips, or glazes.

No Artificial Flavors or Preservatives
Made with simple, reliable ingredients and trusted Betty Crocker quality.

Kosher Certified & Box Tops Eligible
Supports a wide range of dietary preferences and helps schools through the Box Tops for Education program.

Benefits

Homemade Taste, No Hassle
Delivers the classic flavor of pound cake without needing to make it from scratch.

Perfect for Any Occasion
Serve it for breakfast, dessert, afternoon tea, or holidays—it fits every table and mood.

Budget- and Family-Friendly
Affordable and makes multiple servings—ideal for family gatherings or meal prepping sweet treats.

Reliable Results Every Time
Rises beautifully, bakes evenly, and stays moist—easy success in every box.

Fun to Personalize
Use it as a blank canvas to create your signature twist—drizzle it, frost it, or layer it up.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Corn Syrup, Palm Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Corn Starch, Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Salt, Monoglycerides, Xanthan Gum, Dicalcium Phosphate, Wheat Starch, Artificial Flavor, Color Added.
